whatThisIs: The Captain's own hand-maintained continuity record, kept beside the generated CHECKPOINT.json rather than inside it, because that file is rewritten by the generator chain on every run and a hand edit there would be lost. Read this to resume the execution loop after a compaction, a container restart or a usage boundary. A checkpoint is not completion.

boundaries: No production deployment, live payment or authentication change, participant-data exposure, force-push, destructive reset, permission bypass, new recurring automation, or additional spending.
No increase in peak worker concurrency and no additional paid usage. Replenish a completed worker only for genuinely independent work.
Not a blanket screening re-sign, not approval of new eligibility behaviour, not a waiver of an unresolved legal decision.
Exposure alone does not prove a delivered artifact defective. Correct confirmed defects, document unaffected outputs, leave unmeasured cases unresolved rather than inventing a verdict.
A repair author may not independently approve that repaired candidate.
Changed bytes require newly bound acceptance evidence. Never relabel an old receipt as covering changed output.
